independent_check: 2026/27 production history: unified_history(store.load_picks()) season 2026 and store.load_markets() (pre-kick-off probabilities, recorded / archived real prices); Main of each match = the stored Main; calibrators fitted on 2025/26 walk-forward predictions; matches settled in the data snapshot below
selection_rule: constraints on BOTH 2023/24 and 2024/25: a Risk for >= 99.5 % of the matches with a Main, >= 85 % of the settled Risk picks priced, average odds of the bets >= 2.80; preferred = the highest pooled 2023+2024 ROI among the rules whose ROI is higher than the current rule's on BOTH seasons (ties: the higher worst-season ROI), otherwise the current rule; challenger = the best eligible non-current rule by pooled ROI, tested on 2026/27 in any case

frozen_parameters.calibration: Platt per selection type on the previous season, p in [0.05, 0.75], >= 300 rows; blend: logistic on logit(p_model), logit(p_market) per selection type (a type without its own fit uses the blend pooled over all types; no complete book -> Platt); reliability test z >= -1.96, n >= 100; all fitted on 2025/26 for the 2026/27 check

strategies_evaluated_on_2026: Calibrated Risk (бленд с рынком), пол нет
odds band x EV floor grid (25 cells)

hypotheses.H1: No Risk strategy has a positive ROI on 2026/27 (expected: all negative).
hypotheses.H2: The preferred / challenger strategy has a higher ROI than the current rule on 2026/27.
hypotheses.H3: In p 0.12-0.40 the model over-estimates rare outcomes (observed < mean p) on 2026/27.
hypotheses.H4: Among priced Risk candidates realised ROI rises with model EV with a slope well below 1.

decision_criteria_for_a_future_productio.C1: challenger (or preferred, if not the current rule) ROI on 2026/27 > current ROI on 2026/27
decision_criteria_for_a_future_productio.C2: paired match-bootstrap 95 % CI of the ROI difference on 2026/27 entirely above 0
decision_criteria_for_a_future_productio.C3: ROI difference > 0 in each of 2023/24, 2024/25, 2025/26 and 2026/27
decision_criteria_for_a_future_productio.rule: replace the current Risk only if C1, C2 and C3 all hold; otherwise keep it and re-test when the 2026/27 history has at least twice as many settled priced Risk bets
